entries.definition: Whether the evidence, viewed under the governing legal standard, is legally sufficient to support a verdict, conviction, finding, or judgment.
include_when: The court tests whether evidence could legally support the challenged result.
The opinion applies a sufficiency standard to an adjudicated finding.
exclusions: A challenge only to the relative weight or credibility of evidence.
Pleading sufficiency or substantial-evidence review of agency action.

entries.scope_note: Whether counsel's deficient performance prejudiced a criminal defendant or post-conviction petitioner under the governing effectiveness standard.
entries.definition: Whether counsel's deficient performance prejudiced a criminal defendant or post-conviction petitioner under the governing effectiveness standard.
include_when: The court evaluates deficient performance, prejudice, or an equivalent ineffective-assistance test.
exclusions: A denial of counsel without analysis of counsel's performance.
Ordinary disagreement with litigation strategy outside an effectiveness claim.

entries.scope_note: Whether appointed appellate counsel may withdraw because an appeal is frivolous and whether independent judicial review reveals any nonfrivolous issue.
entries.definition: Whether appointed appellate counsel may withdraw because an appeal is frivolous and whether independent judicial review reveals any nonfrivolous issue.
include_when: The opinion applies Anders or an equivalent no-merit appellate procedure.
exclusions: Any ordinary finding that an appeal or argument is frivolous.

entries.scope_note: Whether a prosecution, conviction, or punishment violates the constitutional prohibition against successive prosecution or multiple punishment for the same offense.

include_when: The court applies double-jeopardy, merger, same-elements, or multiple-punishment analysis.
exclusions: Generic claim preclusion or duplicate civil claims.
A lesser-included-offense issue without a double-jeopardy question.

entries.scope_note: Whether a habeas or Section 2255 applicant has made the showing required for appellate review.

entries.scope_note: Whether a habeas petitioner exhausted available state remedies before seeking federal habeas relief.

entries.scope_note: Whether the jury should have been instructed on, or a conviction may rest on, a lesser included offense.

entries.scope_note: Whether a government official is shielded from civil liability because the asserted right was not clearly established or no constitutional violation occurred.
entries.definition: Whether a government official is shielded from civil liability because the asserted right was not clearly established or no constitutional violation occurred.
include_when: The court applies the qualified-immunity framework to an individual government official.
exclusions: Absolute judicial, prosecutorial, legislative, or sovereign immunity.

entries.scope_note: Whether a federal court may or should exercise jurisdiction over additional claims under the supplemental-jurisdiction doctrine.
entries.definition: Whether a federal court may or should exercise jurisdiction over additional claims under the supplemental-jurisdiction doctrine.
include_when: The court applies 28 USC 1367 or the common-nucleus and discretionary-declination framework.
exclusions: Whether original federal-question or diversity jurisdiction exists.

entries.scope_note: Whether an incarcerated plaintiff properly exhausted available administrative remedies as required by the Prison Litigation Reform Act.
entries.definition: Whether an incarcerated plaintiff properly exhausted available administrative remedies as required by the Prison Litigation Reform Act.
include_when: The court applies PLRA exhaustion, availability, proper-exhaustion, or grievance-procedure rules.
exclusions: Habeas exhaustion of state remedies.
Generic administrative exhaustion outside the PLRA.

entries.scope_note: Whether a federal court should abstain from interfering with qualifying ongoing state proceedings under Younger.
entries.definition: Whether a federal court should abstain from interfering with qualifying ongoing state proceedings under Younger.
include_when: The court applies the Younger abstention requirements or exceptions.
exclusions: Review of a completed state judgment or a generic comity reference.

entries.scope_note: Whether a federal district court lacks jurisdiction over a de facto appeal from a state-court judgment.
entries.definition: Whether a federal district court lacks jurisdiction over a de facto appeal from a state-court judgment.
include_when: The court applies the Rooker-Feldman requirements to injury caused by a state judgment.
exclusions: Ordinary preclusion, parallel proceedings, or review of executive action.

entries.scope_note: Whether a judge or judicial officer has absolute immunity for conduct performed in a judicial capacity within jurisdiction.

include_when: The court analyzes judicial capacity, jurisdiction, or the scope of absolute judicial immunity.
exclusions: Qualified immunity or sovereign immunity of a government entity.

entries.scope_note: Whether dismissal is warranted or valid because a party failed to prosecute, comply with scheduling obligations, or obey litigation orders.

exclusions: Voluntary dismissal or dismissal because a pleading fails to state a claim.

entries.scope_note: Whether a verdict or finding is contrary to the manifest or great weight of the evidence under the applicable review standard.

entries.scope_note: Whether a criminal sentence is procedurally or substantively reasonable under the governing appellate sentencing standard.
